name: [S3] Impossible Squid Game! Glass Bridge!
desc:
Welcome to the ORIGINAL Impossible Glass Bridge! (Squid Game)! Do you have what it takes to conquer the Glass Bridge? 🏆

⭐ Bridge Owner: you're able to control the whole game!
⭐ PREMIUM Benefits: Chat Tag, Premium Icon and a Half the time for Lucky Block.

NEW UPDATE AT 150,000 LIKES!!! 👍
